name: Choice_1
short_caption: The robot gently lifts both hands in front of its chest, palms facing slightly upward and inward, as if offering options.
movement_description: Starting from a neutral posture, the robot smoothly raises both arms forward and slightly inward. The right hand extends a bit lower and more open, while the left hand rises slightly higher with fingers curved, creating a balanced but asymmetrical presentation gesture at chest height. It holds this posture briefly before lowering both arms back down to its sides, returning to the neutral resting position.
